_comment: A user's surface map (surfaces.json). Names resolve here first, then to the shipped tools/surfaces/<name>.json. Each entry may point at its own overlay, add guidance, and list approved excerpts from the same series for authoring. Paths are relative to this file. Pass it with --surfaces, or PHERKAD_SURFACES, or keep it as ./surfaces.json.
